node.statement: Trace calculation on the same quotient. The finite simplicial model gives breve-calU finite CW type and finite-dimensional total real cohomology; the package makes it connected and an H-space and makes breve-sigma a left inversion. Therefore lem-stage1-left-inversion-trace applies and gives Tr(breve-sigma^{*k}:H^k(breve-calU;reals)->H^k(breve-calU;reals))=(-1)^k b_k for every k>=0, where b_k=dim_reals H^k(breve-calU;reals).
